04 / A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Curiosity
is welcome.

Explore Hermes documentation ↗
What is Atlas Cloud?+

Atlas is an original interface concept for a cloud-based AI agent. This website lets you explore the design and try a simulated agent setup. It is an independent project, inspired by Hermes Cloud.

Can I launch a real AI agent here?+

The launch flow creates a demo workspace in this browser session. A live service would require a connected AI provider, hosting infrastructure, and authentication. This preview does not provision servers or run AI tasks.

What happens to my demo workspace?+

It stays available while this page remains open. Reloading clears the demo. Your setup is not sent to a server, and you do not need to enter an API key or payment details.

Can I change my configuration?+

Yes. Open your workspace and select “New configuration” to try another name, focus, region, or plan. Every setting is free to explore.

Is Atlas affiliated with Nous Research?+

No. Atlas has its own identity and original artwork. Hermes Cloud provided design inspiration; Nous Research does not operate or endorse this site.
